findings.text: BL-8 replicated at the pinned snapshot: HF-14's remaining hits are 526 records in 11 files, every one historical (archives, incoming shards, worker snapshots/proposals). Canonical ledger and live build inputs: 0 forbidden-key rows, 0 HF-14 hits.

The 00:38:20 report's own measurement is reproduced exactly: the 8 files it names carry 346 records (report: 346). The live set has since grown to 11 files / 526 records, because review workers snapshot the pre-rev3 ledger; new files: ['artifacts/worker-029/live_hf2902/ledger_pre_rev3_snapshot.jsonl', 'artifacts/worker-036/classsep_disj_rule/snapshots/theorems.ce42d205e761.jsonl', 'artifacts/worker-097/l0_rev4_review/snapshots/theorems.pre-rev3-20260912T003026.jsonl']. The count is monotone in review activity, so no legitimate repair of the live corpus can drive it to zero.

Fix direction validated by control: an allowlist predicate (canonical ledger + live batch-*.jsonl) returns 0 violations on the live corpus, still fires on a tampered canonical ledger (C4), and fails closed when the canonical file is absent (C6). A path denylist is unsafe: C7 shows a canonical file under a 'snapshots/' path silently passing.

BL-8's HF-03 sub-claim is only partly the same shape: of HF-03's 15 files, 12 are live work products (artifacts/literature/registry.jsonl, 97 records; artifacts/literature/sources/batch-*.jsonl, 104 records) and 3 are historical copies. HF-03's live portion is repairable by the deferred BL-2 metadata patch and is not structurally unfalsifiable. Only HF-14 is measured here as never-zero.

The allowlist must be paired with a path/role registry pinned by hash (or a map field), otherwise a future canonical path can be added and be silently out of scope. Recommendation includes 'canonical set declared in one pinned manifest; absent entry => violation'.

non_claims: no canonical file was modified; this report is advisory evidence

recommendation.do_not: Do not patch or delete the archives/snapshots: they are the record of what was actually reviewed at ce42d205, and deleting them would make the audit record unfalsifiable in the other direction.
recommendation.rule: Run HF-14 (and path-scoped HFs) over an allowlist: (1) the canonical ledger ledger/theorems.jsonl and (2) the live build inputs artifacts/literature/theorems/batch-*.jsonl, with the allowlist itself declared in one hash-pinned manifest so a missing canonical file or a renamed canonical path is a violation (fail closed). Keep the corpus-wide scan for information, report historical hits as a separate advisory count, never as a blocking HF.
